name: git-worktree
title: A thread in a git repository works in its own worktree
about: The person picks a git repository as the thread's folder. The thread runs on its own branch in its own worktree; the person's checkout (HEAD, branch, status) is the same afterwards; the band shows the folder and branch; the run card shows the changed files.

steps.expect: The repository is added as a project and chosen in the composer's picker
The run edits in its worktree (its edit asked and allowed) and finishes
The pane's Overview shows the working folder and its neko/ branch (the band no longer does)
The thread sits under the acme-api section; the band and the window's title name the project
The run card shows the changes

steps.name: worktree-done
steps.expect: Folder, branch and the run card with changed files
The person's checkout is untouched: same HEAD, branch and status
The work happened in a worktree on a neko/ branch

sh.run: git -C files/acme-api worktree list --porcelain | sed -n 's/^worktree //p' | tail -n 1 | xargs -I{} git -C {} status --porcelain

steps.expect: The worktree holds the agent's change
